title: Run status
description: runs/<paper-slug>/status.json. Only the bot that owns the current stage writes it.

paper.description: Paper slug. Matches the directory name under runs/.

stage.description: Who may write next. done means the Writer has published the report.

owner_bot.description: Role or bot name that owns this stage.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last handoff write.

commit.description: Git commit the owner is publishing with this status, or a specimen label.

notes.description: One short note for the next bot. Not a verdict.
